# TheArtStory

> > Comprehensive art history resource covering classical, modern, and contemporary artists, movements, and ideas from Leonardo da Vinci and Impressionism to Banksy and Pop Art.

TheArtStory is an educational platform providing in-depth biographies of influential artists like Pablo Picasso, Jackson Pollock, and Andy Warhol, along with detailed explorations of major art movements including Abstract Expressionism, Bauhaus, Dada, and Art Nouveau. The site serves as a comprehensive reference for understanding visual art history from classical periods through contemporary practice.

## Key Topics

- Abstract Expressionism
- Leonardo da Vinci
- Pablo Picasso
- Jackson Pollock
- Andy Warhol
- Banksy
- Pop Art
- Impressionism
- Bauhaus
- Dada
- Art Nouveau
- Expressionism
- Modern art movements
- Contemporary art
- Artist biographies

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](http://www.normalmacm.com/): Homepage featuring artists like Picasso, Banksy, Warhol, and Basquiat
- [Artists Directory](http://www.normalmacm.com/artists/): Artist directory with biographies of da Vinci, van Gogh, Picasso, Kahlo
- [Art Movements](http://www.normalmacm.com/movements/): Art movements directory covering Pop Art, Surrealism, Impressionism

## Educational Content

- [Art Ideas & Concepts](http://www.normalmacm.com/ideas/): Art concepts, definitions, and Renaissance techniques by TheArtStory
- [Modern Art Timelines](http://www.normalmacm.com/section-timelines.htm): Chronological timelines of modern art periods from Art Nouveau to Pop Art

## Blog & Updates

- [Art History Blog](http://www.normalmacm.com/blog/): Art history blog covering ChatGPT, Abstract Expressionism, AI tools
